product.title: Shark and Wildlife Viewing Adventure in Key West

description.text: The whole family can learn more about sharks and other marine wildlife on this boat tour from Key West. Travel on board an eco-friendly, 34-foot catamaran just a few miles off the coast to try your luck spotting dolphins, stingrays, turtles, and birds while you learn more about Key West’s waters than you ever would sailing along. Then watch as the pilot drops bait to draw a variety of sharks right to the edge of the boat.Cold drinks, snacks, and polarized sunglasses are included View lemon, nurse and other shark species from the safety of your catamaran An ideal experience for nature-lovers, b Ideal for travelers basing in Key West who want a guided Florida Keys experience without coordinating boats, gear, or launch times on their own.
